title: Quasi-Bosonic Ground States and Excitation Spectra
exact_target: Extend the quasi-bosonic energy approximation to the actual many-body ground state and higher excitation spectrum.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006480 (OWR-14299579-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Arbeitsgemeinschaft: Analysis of Many-body Quantum Systems (2025), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2025/46, pp. 2491--2544. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: Energy convergence alone does not imply convergence of states. The statement retains both the transformed-state and excited-spectrum questions.
